description: This file contains an in-memory implementation of the IMembershipTable interface for testing purposes within the Orleans framework. It manages membership entries, supports operations like insert, update, delete, and read, and maintains versioning and concurrency control.

classes.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
classes.description: A mock implementation of IMembershipTable for testing, storing membership data in memory with thread safety and version control.

methods.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
methods.description: Default constructor for the in-memory membership table.

methods.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the table with a specific version and entries.

methods.name: Calls
methods.description: Property returning a copy of the list of method calls made to the table.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the membership entries and advances the version.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries marked as dead and older than a specified date.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Records a call to delete entries for a specific cluster.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Records a call to initialize the membership table.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Attempts to insert a new membership entry, returns success status.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Returns all membership entries and current version.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Returns the membership data for a specific silo address.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a specific membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Attempts to update an existing membership entry with concurrency control.
